session_security.csrf: base64url(HMAC-SHA256(key, UTF8(token_id))) without padding; header verified against the authenticated session; cookie is delivery only
session_security.key_file: ANTNEST_EDGE_CSRF_KEY_FILE; exactly 32 raw secret bytes; same key on all replicas
session_security.private_session_identifier: login/OIDC token_id; subsequent trusted Identity CCT sid; never browser JSON
session_security.admin_origin: phase 2 plan in session-security.md; not implemented in this revision

origin_admission.scope: /api/* before routing, authentication and upstream calls
origin_admission.safe_rule: Origin optional; when present require one exact public Origin
origin_admission.mutation_rule: all other methods require matching Origin or, with Origin absent, Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin
origin_admission.metadata_rule: one of same-origin, same-site, cross-site or none; same-site and cross-site reject mutations even with matching Origin; none requires matching Origin
origin_admission.invalid_headers: empty, null, foreign or duplicate Origin rejects; empty, unknown or duplicate Fetch Metadata rejects mutations
origin_admission.originless_compatibility: ANTNEST_EDGE_ALLOW_ORIGINLESS_MUTATIONS=true admits mutations only when both headers are absent; default false with startup warning when enabled
origin_admission.csrf: independent and still required on authenticated mutations
origin_admission.websocket: ACP WebSocket upgrades always require matching Origin

session_validation.identity_unavailable: 503 identity_unavailable; preserve cookies; never admit upstream requests

status.scope: local Gateway readiness; no downstream status requests

start_oidc_login.browser_binding: HttpOnly SameSite=Lax host-only SHA256(state) cookie; newest attempt replaces prior attempt

workspace_bootstrap.agent_activation_state: enabled or disabled, present exactly when lifecycle_state is created
workspace_bootstrap.state_source: Controller management projection in the existing paginated list; no ACP or Runtime lookup

workspace_state.authentication: browser_session; verified Gateway workload and signed Agent-scoped workspace CCT at ACP
workspace_state.scope: original authenticated organization and principal only; no query fields
workspace_state.denied: 200 sanitized offline state; no session or configuration revision disclosure

workspace_state_watch.replay: none; reject query fields and Last-Event-ID
workspace_state_watch.disconnect: cancel upstream observation only; never cancel or replay ACP work
workspace_state_watch.source_failure: 503 before first snapshot; after streaming close without inventing state

workspace_acp_http.authentication: browser_session; direct ACP routing without Controller lookup; ACP owns Agent/Session authorization
workspace_acp_http.csrf: POST and DELETE require exactly one X-Antnest-CSRF-Token matching the authenticated session derivation
workspace_acp_http.origin: shared origin_admission; POST and DELETE require matching public Origin or same-origin Fetch Metadata, unless explicit originless compatibility applies
workspace_acp_http.message_payload: opaque; no ACP translation or login credential forwarding
workspace_acp_http.streaming: unbuffered SSE; client disconnect cancels upstream receive request only
workspace_acp_http.connection_authority: ACP Service; connection ID is not an authentication credential
workspace_acp_http.already_forwarded_work: same policy as WebSocket; no idle authorization polling

workspace_acp.authentication: browser_session; direct ACP routing without Controller lookup; ACP owns Agent/Session authorization
workspace_acp.message_admission: resolve original cookie token before each complete client message; require original User/Organization/Membership and an unexpired handshake CCT; reconnect after expiry (#58 owns renewal)
workspace_acp.message_payload: opaque; no ACP translation or login credential forwarding
workspace_acp.already_forwarded_work: ACP owns authorization, Run, cancellation and disconnect semantics
workspace_acp.idle_connection: no Gateway background polling; ACP owns local access updates and output subscriptions

workspace_bridge_api.trust: verified Gateway workload and signed CCT; principal headers are presentation hints only
workspace_bridge_api.body_limit: at least existing negotiated ACP multimodal input limit

workspace_bridge_events.upstream_disconnect: observation only; never cancel ACP Run

workspace_application.html_identity: signed organization-scoped workspace CCT plus verified presentation hints; SSR discovery only
workspace_application.return_to: validated same-origin /workspace/ path preserving agent and session query

organization_display.transport: X-Antnest-Organization-Slug and X-Antnest-Organization-Name; one canonical unpadded Base64URL value per header, encoding the exact UTF-8 string
organization_display.scope: authenticated Agent UI Workspace API and SSR HTML only; anonymous assets and other upstreams receive neither header
organization_display.validation: required non-whitespace strings; Node rejects missing, duplicate, non-canonical Base64URL or invalid UTF-8 values with 401 before discovery
organization_display.authorization: display only; signed caller-context identities/roles and existing consumer business authorization determine access
organization_display.freshness: no metadata cache; each authenticated request resolves Identity again; re-bootstrap and SSR reload observe the current name without changing session scope
organization_display.deployment: Gateway producer #92 first; Agent UI bootstrap consumer #93 then activates the verifiedWorkspacePrincipal schema; full integration follows both local admissions

service_authentication.workload: Every internal dependency uses the exact platform token/mTLS mode; raw service credentials are re-read per new request or connection and never follow redirects.
service_authentication.caller_context: Identity revision 14 issues a route-selected profile and Agent scope; forward the unchanged CCT in one Antnest-Caller-Context field, keep it outside browser JSON.
service_authentication.browser_sanitization: Remove every case-insensitive X-Antnest-* and Antnest-* field, including unknown names. Capture CSRF and account-switch preconditions privately for local validation; per-route allowlists and server-owned context determine outbound headers.
